decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel remains core to the firm's secure-ecosystem and transaction-authorization strategy, and its low upkeep justifies keeping the option open even though it has not appeared on the website since 2019.

Mobile PDF signing supports the firm's move into online contract signing, and demand for e-signatures grew after 2020, so the feature's value is plausible and cheap to maintain despite its low visibility.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is a platform element underpinning the other offers, so dropping it would destroy many follow-on options.
After four years the niche email-to-app robot has shown no visible traction, so its uncertainty has resolved unfavourably and its resources are better redeployed to core development.

Payment-security compliance stays relevant under evolving payment regulation, so the suite keeps its value as an option, though its absence from the website suggests it may be folded into the broader offer.
